scope: Proposition 3.1 of the manuscript “A Polynomial-Time Algorithm for Three-Machine Unit-Job Scheduling” (preprints/A-polynomial-time-algorithm-for-three-machine-unit-job-scheduling-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 124 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2080c4ad5953f225), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: This is a uniform deterministic polynomial-time algorithm. Every set it accepts has a full schedule, which the algorithm can explicitly return. With K = 10000, its deadline decision and schedule construction take O((L + 2)150020) deterministic multitape steps.
